name: icon
title: Icon
description: Every glyph in Looseleaf is a hand-drawn felt-tip icon, redrawn at each size so a 16 px chevron is a chevron and not a shrunken 24 px one. It takes lucide names, so a shadcn snippet keeps working.

a11y: Decorative by default: `aria-hidden="true"` and `focusable="false"`. Pass `label` when the icon is the only content of a control, or name the control instead.
Ink is `currentColor`, so text color utilities and forced-colors mode work; icons are kept in forced-colors mode.
Status icons differ by silhouette, not only by color: a triangle warns, an octagon stops, a ring informs, an arc waits.
